meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing (so `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` resolves) is handed off to the human maintainer, who raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理版本号并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布前都要手动改版本号和写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps and release workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version numbers and changelogs before every release

howto.what: 当用户要求发布插件新版本时，Claude 会自动分析改动类型，更新所有版本号文件，执行构建与同步，提交推送代码，创建 Git 标签，创建 GitHub Release，更新变更日志，并发送 Discord 通知。npm 发布交给人类。
howto.when: 当用户要求发布新版本、递增版本号或完成发布流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我发布一个新版本，这次是修复 bug 的补丁版本
say.note: Claude 会分析并执行完整发布流程

say.text: 把版本号从 1.2.3 升到 1.3.0，并走完整发布流程
say.note: Claude 会更新并同步所有相关文件

say.text: 执行版本发布，但 npm 发布部分留给人类
say.note: Claude 会把 npm 发布步骤留给你

howto.what_en: Automates version bump and release workflow for Claude Code plugins: updates version strings, verifies build, commits/tags/pushes, creates GitHub release, regenerates changelog, sends Discord notification. NPM publishing is handed to human.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to release a new version, bump the version, or complete the release workflow.

say_en.text: Help me release a new patch version for a bug fix.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and run the full release process.

say_en.text: Bump the version from 1.2.3 to 1.3.0 and run the full release flow.
say_en.note: Claude will update and sync all relevant files.

say_en.text: Run the release process, but leave the npm publish to a human.
say_en.note: Claude will hand off the npm publishing step.
